title.zh: Bitcoin Dips, But Its Forks Are Flying Again
title.en: Bitcoin Dips, But Its Forks Are Flying Again

current_state.zh: Bitcoin Cash and Bitcoin SV surged (roughly 30% and 20% respectively) as traders rotated into Bitcoin forks following CME Group's announcement that it will launch BCH and Uniswap futures on Oct. 19, while Bitcoin itself pulled back toward $84,000 after nearing a seven-month high.
